$description: The mark's construction. Every value is a whole number of ninths of one outer stroke width. Changing one changes the mark; gates/check-geometry.mjs holds the build to these.

unit.$description: Ninths per outer stroke width. The whole mark is integers on this grid.

stroke.$description: Outer stroke width. The unit everything else is measured in.

middle.$description: Middle stroke. Was 8.18 in the original artwork, a 2.2% change.

gap.$description: Counter between strokes. Was 2.91, a 3.1% change. Now equal to the cut.

cut.$description: Vertical drop of every angled cut. Unchanged from the original.

bar.$description: Base bar thickness. Was 7.82, a 2.3% change. Now equal to the middle stroke.

barTop.$description: Bar's top edge at the right of the mark. Was 21.18.

middleTop.$description: Middle stroke's top at its right edge. Was 10.10.

height.$description: Mark height. Width is 2*stroke + middle + 2*gap = 32, so the mark is square.

gap.$description: Counter for the sub-48px cut. Makes the mark 36 wide against 32 high.

threshold.$description: Pixels of rendered mark width below which the small cut is used.

outlineWeight.$description: Inset of the outline variant's hole, in ninths.

capHeight.$description: Wordmark cap height in ninths, so a capital is one stroke width tall.

gap.$description: Artwork to type, in cap heights. Was 0.98 and 0.86 in the two original lockups.

clearSpace.$description: Minimum empty space around any lockup, in ninths. One stroke width.

opticalCorrection.$description: Share of the area centroid's deviation applied when centring the mark in a box.
